description: This file defines the CalculatorManager class and related enums for managing calculator modes, precision, memory commands, and display interactions within a calculator application. It includes method declarations for setting display states, handling memory, modes, history, and commands, and references external classes and interfaces such as CCalcEngine, CalculatorHistory, and ICalcDisplay.

classes.name: CalculatorManager
classes.description: A final class implementing ICalcDisplay to manage calculator operations, modes, history, and display updates within the calculation application.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Sets the primary display string and error state.

methods.name: SetIsInError
methods.description: Sets the error state of the calculator display.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the expression display with tokens and commands.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbers
methods.description: Updates the display of memorized numbers.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when a new history item is added.

methods.name: SetParenthesisNumber
methods.description: Sets the count of parentheses in the display.

methods.name: OnNoRightParenAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when no right parenthesis is added.

methods.name: DisplayPasteError
methods.description: Displays an error related to paste operation.

methods.name: MaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Handles the event when maximum digits are reached.

methods.name: BinaryOperatorReceived
methods.description: Handles the event when a binary operator is received.

methods.name: MemoryItemChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to a memory item.

methods.name: InputChanged
methods.description: Handles input change events.

methods.name: CalculatorManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the calculator manager with display callback and resource provider.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the calculator state, optionally clearing memory.

methods.name: SetStandardMode
methods.description: Sets the calculator to standard mode.

methods.name: SetScientificMode
methods.description: Sets the calculator to scientific mode.

methods.name: SetProgrammerMode
methods.description: Sets the calculator to programmer mode.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the calculator engine.

methods.name: MemorizeNumber
methods.description: Stores the current number in memory.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberLoad
methods.description: Loads a memorized number into the calculator.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberAdd
methods.description: Adds a memorized number to the current value.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberSubtract
methods.description: Subtracts a memorized number from the current value.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberClear
methods.description: Clears a specific memorized number.

methods.name: MemorizedNumberClearAll
methods.description: Clears all memorized numbers.

methods.name: IsEngineRecording
methods.description: Checks if the engine is recording.

methods.name: IsInputEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is empty.

methods.name: SetRadix
methods.description: Sets the number radix for display.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbersString
methods.description: Updates the string representation of memorized numbers.

methods.name: GetResultForRadix
methods.description: Gets the calculation result formatted for a specific radix and precision.

methods.name: SetPrecision
methods.description: Sets the display precision.

methods.name: UpdateMaxIntDigits
methods.description: Updates the maximum integer digits allowed.

methods.name: DecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator character.

methods.name: GetHistoryItems
methods.description: Returns the list of history items.

methods.name: GetHistoryItems (mode)
methods.description: Returns the list of history items for a specific mode.

methods.name: SetHistoryItems
methods.description: Sets the history items.

methods.name: GetHistoryItem
methods.description: Returns a specific history item by index.

methods.name: RemoveHistoryItem
methods.description: Removes a history item by index.

methods.name: ClearHistory
methods.description: Clears all history items.

methods.name: MaxHistorySize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of history.

methods.name: GetCurrentDegreeMode
methods.description: Returns the current degree mode command.

methods.name: SetInHistoryItemLoadMode
methods.description: Sets whether the calculator is in history item load mode.

methods.name: GetDisplayCommandsSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of display commands.
